title: Ensure 'Enable RPC Endpoint Mapper Client Authentication' is set to 'Enabled' (MS only)
remediation: Set GP: Computer Configuration\Policies\Administrative Templates\System\Remote Procedure Call\Enable RPC Endpoint Mapper Client Authentication to 'Enabled'
reason: Anonymous access to RPC services could result in accidental disclosure of information to unauthenticated users.

title: Ensure 'Restrict Unauthenticated RPC clients' is set to 'Enabled: Authenticated' (MS only)
remediation: Set GP: Computer Configuration\Policies\Administrative Templates\System\Remote Procedure Call\Restrict Unauthenticated RPC clients to 'Enabled: Authenticated'
reason: Unauthenticated RPC communication can create a security vulnerability.
